title: minifiedCode lane one-shot baseline
description: The set of scanner PLACE keys grandfathered when the minifiedCode lane was first captured for a repo, plus the journal of every capture and refresh. Applied by loadBaseline() in monitor/minify-baseline.mjs; a document that fails this schema is treated exactly as an unreadable one — it grandfathers NOTHING and the CLI refuses to overwrite it. The category segment of every place key is pinned to `minifiedCode` on purpose: monitor/issue-store.mjs consults these keys as one flat set across EVERY scanner category, so a key naming another lane would silently suppress a finding this file has no authority over.

repos.description: repo name -> its one capture. Empty is the normal state until an operator captures.

sliceHash.description: sha256 of the sorted key list, truncated to 16. What anchors 'this is what was captured' to something a reader can recompute.

placeKeys.description: May be empty — a repo captured with nothing minified is a real capture, and the journal entry is what records that it happened.

items.description: sc:<repo>|minifiedCode|<rule>|<file>. Line-free, permanently: a place key that carried a line would un-grandfather itself the next time an unrelated edit moved the file.

journal.description: Append-only record of captures and refreshes. Required, and required even when empty: an absent journal beside a populated `repos` is capture history that was lost, and one-shot capture is only enforceable against a record of what was already done.

action.description: refresh is the operator override of one-shot capture. An unrecognised action would read as neither, which is how a re-baseline stops looking like one.
